name: Mobile FPS Bypass
description: FPS bypass for Android32 and Android64 with a smooth draggable menu.

enabled.name: Enable FPS Bypass
enabled.description: Turns the bypass on or off.

disable-vsync.name: Disable V-Sync
disable-vsync.description: Lets the game render above the screen refresh rate.

show-button.name: Show floating button
show-button.description: Draggable bubble that opens the FPS menu.

hide-in-level.name: Hide button in level
hide-in-level.description: Hides the bubble while playing; pause to see it.
